name: Felipe Matheus
headline: I build, architect and ship software, with AI in the loop and users at the center.
description: Felipe Matheus, Software Engineer in Brasília. Co-founder & CTO of Macronutri. Full-stack, software architecture and AI systems, with a UX research background.
bio: I'm a Software Engineering student at the University of Brasília (UnB) and an AI Resident at LabLivre × Instituto Eldorado.
I design, build and ship software, with AI in the architecture and in the workflow.
As co-founder and CTO of Macronutri, I took a no-code prototype to a production SaaS in three weeks. I made the architecture calls; AI coding agents handled the implementation.
My background in UX keeps real users at the center of what I build.
I care about systems that are reliable, secure, and useful to people.
intro: I build, architect and ship software, with AI in the loop and users at the center.
I'm Brazilian, based in Brasília. Outside of code, I go to the gym, play bass and strategy games, and draw a little.
